source.note: Recorded from a clean checkout of the commit named in head (git status was empty when it was written); ordinary Normal gen-2 (arrivals on) at tick 48000, the rules 260, 261 and 262 pin world, kept because it already holds state rules 263 added: one feast that is a coming of age (Occasion.comingOfAge, one young person named) and five households with a record of a child settled for the night (Household.settled); it holds no bereavement card that says whom was lost (LifeEvent.of), no sit with the grieving and no settling in progress at that tick, so a sit with the grieving and a settling caught mid-sit are not exercised by this pin and are covered by the staged tests only; saved and continued 120 ticks. The counts beside the digests are of the saved world.
